sulidae_utils.ponder.cannon_crafting/can: Cannon blocks placed in survival will not connect to other cannon blocks.
The Welding Blowtorch can quickly connect two cannon blocks at a time.
Right-click two adjacent cannon blocks to weld them together.
The cannon blocks must align, connect, have the same material, and have the same cannon type. Additionally, the Welder must have fuel.
By default, the Welding Blowtorch cannot weld some cannon materials and/or types together.
The Welding Blowtorch can weld different types of cannon.
Welding cannon blocks together can weaken certain types of cannon.
It is recommended to craft and move cannon pieces in their entirety instead.
